description: Curate Gaia bot crawler branches into real-skill catalog entries and clean up processed bot/* branches. Use when the user says: "process bot branches", "curate the crawl output", "clean up bot proposals", "run bot curation", "merge the crawler results", "review bot/* branches", "ingest crawler data", or explicitly types /gaia-bot-curate. Also triggers when the user asks to review pending `bot/*` branches, turn crawler JSON proposals into registry nodes, decide which crawled skills to accept vs reject, or batch-add skills from an automated crawl run. This skill handles the full pipeline: fetch remote bot branches, triage proposals, run `gaia dev` mutations, validate, open a PR, and delete consumed bot branches.
